blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Northern Cebu could emerge as a new investment and industrial growth corridor in the province as Vice Governor Glenn Anthony Soco pushed for the proposed North Cebu Economic Zone (NCEZ). The proposal seeks to expand Cebu’s economic landscape beyond Metro Cebu, positioning the northern part of the province as another center for investment, industrial activity, trade, and job creation. Initial plans identify Bogo City, Medellin, Daanbantayan, and San Remigio as priority development areas.
